top_signals.title: Gold Drops Below $4,000 on Hot Inflation, Tech-Stock Selloff
top_signals.summary: Gold fell below $4,000 an ounce — on track for a second monthly loss — as rising oil prices added to inflationary pressures and a tech-stock selloff raised the risk of investors selling the metal to cover losses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: BYD Earnings Miss Estimates as China's EV Price War Takes Its Toll
top_signals.summary: Chinese electric vehicle giant BYD reported weaker-than-expected third-quarter earnings on Thursday, highlighting the growing challenges facing China's automakers even as overseas sales continue to surge. BYD's net profit rose 28% year-over-year to 10.02 billion yuan ($1.5 billion), missing analysts' expectations of approximately 11.1 billion yuan. Revenue increased 13.6% to 221.5 billion yuan ($33.3 billion), also falling short of market forecasts. The earnings miss comes as the Chinese automaker struggles with fierce competition and slowing demand…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Paschi Investors Deal Crushing Blow to CEO in Win for Intesa
top_signals.summary: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA’s investors overwhelmingly rejected Chief Executive Officer Luigi Lovaglio’s defense against a takeover by Intesa Sanpaolo SpA, setting up the world’s oldest bank for potential loss of its independence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: GLP-1 Demand Boosts Dis-Chem’s South Africa Pharmacy Revenue
top_signals.summary: Dis-Chem Pharmacies Ltd. said surging demand for GLP-1 medicines is helping drive double-digit growth in its dispensary revenue as South Africans increasingly turn to the expensive drugs used to treat diabetes and obesity.

top_signals.title: Jio Boosts India to Top of Global IPO Market With Record October
top_signals.summary: India was the world’s top market for initial public offerings in October, thanks to a record month driven by the blockbuster share sale of Jio Platforms Ltd.

top_signals.title: LNG imports make up increasing share of Colombia's natural gas supply
top_signals.summary: Colombia is importing more liquefied natural gas (LNG) as domestic production continues to fall. A potential drought this fall and winter could limit the availability of hydroelectric generation and boost the country's demand for natural gas power generation. Colombia's government has declared a national disaster in anticipation of a drought resulting from an expected strong El Niño.
